study_design: Prospective case-control analysis within the EPIC-Norfolk cohort
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Odds ratios (ORs) for breast (244 cases, 941 controls), colorectal (221 cases, 886 controls), and prostate (204 cases, 812 controls) cancers were calculated relative to phytoestrogen intake.
reason: The prospective EPIC-Norfolk analysis evaluates overall prostate cancer risk relative to phytoestrogen intake. No aggressive, high-grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal prostate cancer endpoint is reported.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Five hundred nine food items were analyzed by liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry/mass spectrometry, and (13)C(3)-labeled internal standards were analyzed for isoflavones (genistein, daidzein, glycitein, biochanin A, and formononetin), lignans (secoisolariciresinol and matairesinol), and enterolignans from gut microbial metabolism in animal food sources (equol and enterolactone).
estimate_classifications.reason: Genistein was included among the measured phytoestrogens in an analysis of overall prostate cancer risk. The abstract does not report an aggressive endpoint or a genistein-specific numeric estimate with a 95% confidence interval.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
